g.text: Two-Phase Commit (2PC) is a distributed transaction protocol that ensures all

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: participating systems either commit the transaction together or roll it back together,

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: maintaining consistency across multiple services or databases.

g.text: Prepare Phase – The coordinator asks all participants if they are ready to commit the

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji
Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Commit Phase – If all participants respond YES, the coordinator instructs them to commit;

text.font-family: Comic Shanns, monospace, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: otherwise, it instructs them to roll back.
